instruction.text: What is privacy? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Privacy is when you are ((++alone in_public)) and out of the view of others. It is also the ability to keep ((++personal school)) information to yourself.

You have every right to ((++full no)) privacy. You should be allowed to have ((++space the_world)) to yourself. You should also not have to share anything with others that you ((++do_not really)) want to share.

instruction.text: What information can we share with strangers and what should we keep private? Drag the types of information to the correct group.

feedback.finish: You should always keep personal information that can be used against you, or to identify you, private for your safety, especially on the internet.

instruction.text: What are things that you might find safe to share with certain people? Select the two correct answers.

b: ++a bathroom accident
++worries about a friend
your friend’s deepest secrets
++an embarrassing moment you find funny
++who you like and dislike
everything you do in private at home
++worries about your test mark
++feeling unwell at school
your personal diary

feedback.finish: Remember - even though you might feel safe sharing some things with people you trust, you still have every right to keep your secrets to yourself.

instruction.text: How should you behave to respect other people’s privacy in different situations? Select the two correct answers.

atoms.a: Your sibling is upset and has hidden themselves away in their room.
b: ++Knock on their bedroom door and see if they want to let you in.
++Give them space for now.
Barge into their room without asking.

atoms.a: You’ve found someone’s private diary at school.
b: ++Leave it where you found it.
++Hand it back to the owner if you know who it belongs to.
Take a quick peek at a few pages.

atoms.a: Your friend has a crush and you’re curious about who it is.
b: ++Ask if they’re okay with sharing and leave it if they don’t want to.
++Wait to let them tell you about it first if they want to.
Force them to tell you who it is by bribing them with sweets.

atoms.a: You hear your neighbours having an argument in their garden.
b: ++Leave them be and go back indoors.
++Stay in the garden and just focus on what you’re doing.
Peek over the fence and try to listen in on their argument.
